comment: Quick-add vectors shared by web/src/lib/nlp (nlp.test.ts) and internal/quickadd (vectors_test.go), OpenSpec changes quick-add-recurrence, quick-add-nth-weekday and time-tracking (spentMinutes) and day-parts (ctx.dayParts; dayPart and evening are compared when a case states them) and task-energy (ctx.energy; energy, "" for none, is compared when a case states it) and time-sectors (ctx.sectors and ctx.weekStart; sector, "" for none, is compared when a case states it) and quick-add-month-and-every-other (bare months, "every other") and quick-add-by-deadline ("by" words; deadline, "" for none, is compared when a case states it). Every scenario of its spec deltas is a case.
